description: Pedestrian and Cycle counter API for Dublin Region is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dublin City Council. API for the the EcoCounter cycle counters and pedestrian counters in the Dublin region. The sensors update every 15 minutes. The Eco-Visio API enables the development of applications that can interact with Eco-Visio's platform services, such as retrieving counting metadata, traffic history, statistical data or weather data. Coverage: Dublin City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Dublin City Council. Its tags are active travel, api, bicycle, cycle counter, pedestrian-counts. It offers 3 resource(s) in API, CSV, GEOJSON. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
